answer: Answers are salted with a 161 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the ledge salt is published after the onyx checkpoint, the terrace audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 45 keys hence pays for 45 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
